statement: Dispute, reveal, hash-ladder and deposit ops never share a batch with payment, settlement or reserve ops. The Quint cell holds urgent ops apart from payments (urgent-batch-carries-payments); co-signed ops and deposits travel apart under R-COSIGN and J6, and reserve ops are not a kind in the model. The Arrival cell holds the J page's dispute, reveal and deposit ops against the soft ops (spec/j/batch.scm, bug mixed-batch); hash-ladder ops are not an op kind on any page.
